messages.content: Could you tell me the current weather in Boston, MA and also in San Francisco? Please provide the temperatures in Fahrenheit.

message.content:

• [Weather.com “Boston” page]

message.reasoning:
The user asks for "current weather" in two cities with temperatures in Fahrenheit. As an AI without real-time data access (no browsing), I cannot fetch live weather. According to policy, we should not fabricate or guess; instead explain that we can't retrieve up-to-date info.

We can offer general guidance on how to find it via websites like Weather.com, NOAA, etc., but no actual numbers. We could mention typical ranges if needed, but better to say we don't have real-time capability.

Thus respond politely explaining limitation and suggest resources.
